stories.title: NLCS Game 1 & 2 Recap — Brewers Lead Dodgers 2-0
stories.angle: Brewers won Game 1 (2-1 Sunday) and Game 2 (7-4 Monday). Contreras was the hero in G2. Series heads to LA. Division rival Cubs fans have feelings.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Milwaukee is two wins from the World Series.

Brewers beat the Dodgers in Games 1 AND 2 at American Family Field — 2-1 Sunday, 7-4 Monday. Contreras homered, Yamamoto got torched.

Good news for Cubs fans: the Dodgers aren't done yet.

stories.title: Kevin Alcantara — The 2027 Heir Apparent
stories.angle: With Suzuki likely departing, 23-year-old Alcantara (.273/.367/.569, 16 HR at Iowa through June, recalled August) is the heir apparent. Five-tool ceiling, years of team control.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Kevin Alcantara is the name to know this offseason.

The 23-year-old had 16 home runs at Iowa before his August recall. Five-tool ceiling, strong arm, years of team control.

If Suzuki signs elsewhere, Alcantara's ready. The heir apparent is already here.

stories.title: The Rotation Is Broken — Cubs Need 3 SPs This Winter
stories.angle: Horton out until mid-2027 (Tommy John). Gausman expected to leave. Cubs need 3 starters. Bold take: most consequential offseason in years.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The rotation crisis is real.

Cade Horton: out until mid-2027 (Tommy John). Gausman: expected to leave. That's the top of the rotation — both out.

Cubs need three new starters this winter. The most consequential offseason in years.

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong NL MVP — Vote Is in November
stories.angle: Season's final stat line (45 HR, 40+ SB, MLB's WAR leader). BBWAA votes in November. Historical framing — one of the best Cubs position-player seasons ever.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
45 home runs. 40 stolen bases. MLB's best WAR.

Pete Crow-Armstrong didn't just have a great season — he had one of the best by a Cubs position player EVER. The kind of season you put in the history books.

BBWAA MVP vote is in November. Save the date.

stories.title: Skubal Off-Table — Cubs Should Pivot to King + Ryan
stories.angle: Cubs insider poured cold water on Skubal pursuit (projected to set pitcher contract record). Bold redirect: Michael King (if opts out) + Joe Ryan are the real targets.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
A Cubs insider pumped the brakes on Tarik Skubal this week.

Good. Skubal's expected to set a record for pitching contracts. The real targets this winter: Michael King (if he opts out) and Joe Ryan. Those are your two aces.

Now go get them, Carter.
